implementation.note: Real native and browser clients accept F7 view.select request and display tower selection/portrait/commands. Script regression verifies de-duplication and single-consumption requests.

architecture.note: Requests are local presentation state; client filters through visibleSelectionUnit and clears command-card paging. No authoritative simulation write or networking protocol added.

native_api.note: ViewScripts::takeSelectionRequest transfers the queued handles once; native regression checks exact entity and that a second consume returns false.

skill.note: Existing aiverse-view recipe documents author/readback/Studio workflow, bounded generation-safe local requests and the browser/native-verified F7 demo. Catalog check validated 303 skills.

mcp.note: Real script_write/read and viewScripts registration passed; built-server registry audit confirms all declared tools with no missing registrations.

studio.note: Native Studio Scripts panel changed, saved and reopened the view.select source; disk matches. Actual selection behavior covered by native/browser client captures.

inspector.note: Selection behavior is authored as Lua source in existing Scripts editor; no separate entity property was introduced. Editable source loaded, saved and read back in native Studio.

persistence.note: Current selection and pending requests are transient local UI state. This change introduces no persisted selection or new data format. Lua source is saved through existing script authoring.

graphs.note: Local selection requests are Lua presentation commands; no authorable graph or graph evaluation contract is added.

performance.note: Scoped native Debug/Rosetta workload:256-handle selection every update, separate selected animated portrait, and four projectile scenes. Post-warmup CPU120-frame means<=16.04ms, sampled GPU frames<16.67ms,RSS<512MiB. First selection warmup block17.96ms is retained. Allocation review records bounded vectors/pools and fixed-size presentation; no p95/zero-allocation/mobile claim.

platforms.note: Native macOS/Metal and Emscripten7.0.1 browser client exercised the F7 selection request. Windows/Linux/mobile are unverified; no platform-specific selection implementation introduced.

dependencies.note: Uses existing view VM, generation-safe Entity handles and client visibility selection policy; no new dependency.

headless.note: Selection affects local presentation only and is not a headless simulation capability. Native script regression uses an isolated simulation as read-only input.

examples.note: Controls demo F7 uses view.select on the tower, verified in the actual native client and browser.

handoff.note: Cumulative staged handoff records exact implementation/evidence SHAs, actual checks and failures, ownership, known backend limits and remaining final integration steps. Final gate result will be appended after terminal completion.

documentation.note: UI scripting reference documents replace/add selection, handle limit, filtering and local-only behavior.
